newsitem.title: BRAZIL: East Timor activist to visit Brazil.
newsitem.headline: East Timor activist to visit Brazil.

text.p: East Timor activist Jose Ramos-Horta, joint winner of the Nobel Peace Prize, will visit Brazil next week, a spokeswoman for the Presidential Palace said on Tuesday.
The spokeswoman said Ramos-Horta will meet President Fernando Henrique Cardoso on Monday afternoon for talks.
Ramos-Horta, a self-exiled resistance spokesman fighting Indonesian rule in East Timor, won the peace prize last month together with East Timor Roman Catholic Bishop Carlos Belo.
East Timor was annexed by Indonesia in 1975. The United Nations still recognises its former colonial ruler Portugal as the administrative power.
Brazil, the largest Portuguese-speaking nation in the world, has hitherto stuck to a neutral position over East Timor.
